title: Identification of potential biological processes and key genes in diabetes-related stroke through weighted gene co-expression network analysis
body:
##  [ Identification of potential biological processes and key genes in diabetes-related stroke through weighted gene co-expression network analysis ](</content/reactome-research-spotlight/244-identification-of-potential-biological-processes-and-key-genes-in-diabetes-related-stroke-through-weighted-gene-co-expression-network-analysis>)

Using WGCNA, GO and KEGG data analysis tools,[ He Y et al. in the January 2024 issue of BMC Medical Genomics](<https://bmcmedgenomics.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12920-023-01752-z>), established a connection among the genes and pathways associated with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and ischemic stroke (IS) and identified GRN (granulin precursor) as the hub gene in T2D-related stroke. The functional enrichment analysis using Reactome analysis tool for GRN identified [Neutrophil degranulation](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-6798695&PATH=R-HSA-168256,R-HSA-168249>), [Toll-like Receptor Cascades](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-168898&PATH=R-HSA-168256,R-HSA-168249>), [DDX58/IFIH1-mediated induction of interferon-alpha/ beta](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-168928&PATH=R-HSA-168256,R-HSA-168249>), and[ NLR signaling pathways](<https://reactome.org/PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-168643&PATH=R-HSA-168256,R-HSA-168249>) as shared biological processes in T2D and IS.
